item.title: Fire Traffic Alert : Oak Dr. – EMC – Residential Fire
item.description: 7:55 p.m. Firefighters responded to a residential fire reported in the 17800 block of Oak Dr in the Grangerland area where they found the kitchen of a mobile home had a small fire. They’re putting a stop on it now.
